question: Should plugin import hardening land as an enforce-now loader gate, an advisory-first rollout, or a replacement resolver-level boundary after the current bypasses are fixed?
rationale: This PR changes a plugin security boundary and can break existing plugins at load time, so the final enforcement layer and rollout mode need owner intent after the concrete bypasses are repaired.

options.title: Redesign Before Enforcement
options.body: Fix the bypasses and align the policy with runtime resolution before the fail-closed gate can merge.

options.title: Advisory First
options.body: Ship diagnostics or doctor-facing warnings first to measure real plugin compatibility before enforcing load failures.

options.title: Pause Or Replace
options.body: Close or pause this branch if the durable solution should be a resolver-level replacement rather than static loader scanning.

recommendation.title: Redesign Before Enforcement
recommendation.body: Fix the bypasses and align the policy with runtime resolution before the fail-closed gate can merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to and authored by `vincentkoc`, who also has recent merged plugin loader and SDK-boundary history in the same area.
